name: OpenCal
h: shows your free time from all your calendars on one link.
s: People see when you are free. They never see your events.

name: BlockDex
h: searches individual components across public shadcn registries.
s: Each item comes with its install command and dependencies.

name: StackTab
h: prices a database, auth, payments and a host as one monthly bill.
s: See the bill at 1,000, 10,000 and 100,000 users.

name: KitGrade
h: scores SaaS starter kits on what a buyer can check before paying.
s: Each kit is labelled hands-on or documented.

name: @gent
h: runs a coding task you email to yourself.
s: Codex or Claude Code runs it on your computer and replies in the same Gmail thread.

name: ParseRail
h: turns an invoice or receipt into structured JSON.
s: A document parse costs $0.10, with no subscription.

name: OpenComply
h: drafts your filing from your own documents.
s: Every sentence cites the page it came from.

name: OpenJobs
h: tailors each application from one experience bank.
s: OpenJobs sends nothing until you approve it.

name: OpenNews
h: sorts the news on your beat into one roundup.
s: Each item it keeps gets a short summary and a link to its source.

name: OpenReel
h: makes a short narrated video from a Wikipedia article.
s: Your browser makes each video. Your own AI key writes each script.

name: OpenSocials
h: plans the day's posts and waits for your approval.
s: It posts to Bluesky, X, LinkedIn and YouTube today.

name: AgentWire
h: lists new agent tools and AI lab model changes.
s: It also tracks AI coding tool prices and whether a tool is still maintained.

name: Context Window
h: records what changed in the AI labs' own documents.
s: It reads model cards, pricing pages and API changelogs.

name: ToolDrift
h: shows which coding model Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot run tonight.
s: It ranks the models by adoption every night.

name: StillShipping
h: reports which agent tools have stopped shipping.
s: It rescores them every night from the GitHub API.

name: SkillWorks
h: scores every Claude Code skill, subagent and plugin.
s: The score says whether it actually loads.

name: RuleStack
h: indexes real AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files every night.
s: It classifies each file by stack and scores it.

name: The Standup
h: lists the releases, CVEs and outages you have to act on.
s: One email arrives each day at 07:40.

name: Front Wire
h: carries breaking news minutes after the source publishes.
s: Every item links to the agency, filing or outlet it came from.
